description: This file defines a class and functions for interacting with SAP AI Core API, including fetching models and deployments, handling authentication, and filtering models based on criteria. It also exports functions to retrieve models and deployments, and manages a cache of model providers.

classes.name: SapAiCoreFetcher
classes.description: A class responsible for authenticating with SAP AI Core API, fetching models and deployments, and transforming API responses into internal data structures.

methods.name: getDeployments
methods.description: Fetches deployment data from SAP AI Core API.

methods.name: getModels
methods.description: Fetches model data from SAP AI Core API.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Performs OAuth token authentication with SAP AI Core.

methods.name: fetchModels
methods.description: Retrieves and processes models and deployments from SAP AI Core API.

methods.name: filterRawModels
methods.description: Filters models based on provider support, latest version, streaming support, text-generation capability, and context window size.

methods.name: transformDeployment
methods.description: Transforms raw deployment data into Deployment objects.

methods.name: transformModels
methods.description: Transforms raw model data into internal SapAiCoreModel objects.

methods.name: transformModel
methods.description: Transforms a single raw model into SapAiCoreModel, including scenario mapping and model info creation.

methods.name: mapScenarios
methods.description: Maps scenario IDs to internal Scenario types.

methods.name: createModelInfo
methods.description: Creates ModelInfo object from latest version data.

methods.name: findModelDeployments
methods.description: Finds deployments associated with a specific model.

methods.name: isSupportedProvider
methods.description: Checks if a provider is supported.
